_doc: How the abyss warns you as you fall (scripts/match/abyss_fx.gd danger_depth: the red tint and vignette; scripts/match/abyss_fall_sfx.gd warn_db / warn_rate: the heartbeat warning). Depths are metres under the lowest island lip around you. Target law (owner 11-27, the reference is right): nothing shows until start_depth (0.25 m); from there the danger rises (curve = share of the way, to the power curve; the reference curve's keys are not decoded) to 1 at full_before_end metres above the kill depth (Hunter.abyss_kill_y), i.e. 14 m of a 17.5 m drop. Rising faster than the glider lift (AbyssFx.RISE_OFF) or climbing back above start_depth lets go. warn_*: the warning heartbeat starts at danger warn_from (0.089 = the tint 3 m under the lip on the 17.5 m drop, the reference's audio start), at warn_db_min dB and warn_rate_min beats a second, and rises to warn_db_max dB and warn_rate_max at full danger. edge_from: danger where the crimson screen-edge rings start (they ramp up to full at 1).
